role: Real-trajectory model-interface qualification, not controller return superiority
q_semantics: Number of parallel complete rollout streams; distinct agents per game are separate
normalization: Unchanged HARL ValueNorm including its evolving mean and scale in the lifted empirical-risk state
predictor: Exact gradient and directional Hessian of the sensor empirical potential at its frozen anchor; no learned curve fitting
actor_potential: Unclipped PPO surrogate plus the frozen entropy coefficient; not true return
critic_potential: Unnormalized Monte Carlo reward-to-go tracking MSE on disjoint complete episodes
coupling_law: Per episode, a common Bernoulli coin chooses all-shared versus independent environment/action seeds; every stream marginal remains native
scope: Empirical neural MAPPO actor/critic response and state-transfer qualification only; no Markov confidence, policy-return certificate, or online-controller benefit claim
stop_rule: No outcome-based changes, retries, task removal, or GPU performance authorization after a mandatory gate failure. Preserve every payload and diagnostic.
